# ToggleButtons { #anylumino.ToggleButtons }

```python
ToggleButtons(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    button_style='',
    tooltips=None,
    icons=None,
    icon_family='classic',
    icon_variant='solid',
    icon_library='default',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Segmented toggle-button selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                                       | Default     |
|--------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| index | optional | Selected option index. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| button_style | optional | Visual variant such as ``'primary'``, ``'success'``, or ``'danger'``. | `''` |
| tooltips | optional | Per-option tooltips. | `None` |
| icons | optional | Web Awesome icon names or per-option icon dictionaries for toggle-button options. | `None` |
| icon_family | optional | Web Awesome icon family, for example ``'classic'``. | `'classic'` |
| icon_variant | optional | Web Awesome icon variant, for example ``'solid'`` or ``'regular'``. | `'solid'` |
| icon_library | optional | Web Awesome icon library, for example ``'default'``. | `'default'` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
